title: Remittance intake message (Service Bus remittance-intake queue)
description: Claim-check reference to a raw message already written to Blob incoming/. Never carries MSG/EML or attachment bytes. Service Bus MessageId = processingId (duplicate detection) except reprocess, which uses processingId:uuid.

processingId.description: REM- + first 20 hex chars of the source SHA-256; also the Durable instance id.

force.description: Bypass the already-Extracted duplicate check (explicit reprocess).
